text:
maya: Heads-up — the cost dashboard shows negative cache savings for /summarize on prod after the routing tweak.

sam: Negative savings? can you paste the numbers or screenshot?

maya: Screenshot attached in thread (not in this export). Quick query that reproduces the rollup: 
```
SELECT route, model, sum(prefetch_tokens) as p_tokens, sum(hotpath_tokens) as h_tokens, 
  sum(prefetch_cost) - sum(hotpath_saved) as net_savings
FROM billing_rollups
WHERE date >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND route = '/summarize'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
Result shows net_savings = -$420 for redwood-1.2 which seems wrong.

jess: @maya that often means prefetched KV got attributed twice — once to the prefetcher and again when hotpath used the cached value. We switched router to favor model-v2 in warm pools last deploy which changed pathing.

frank: Could we attribute by invocation path id? If prefetch emits lineage_id and hotpath references it we can deduct.

jess: We emit `prefetch_tag` currently but we downsample high-QPS routes to keep telemetry volume sane. Sampling is why rollups don't reconstruct lineage reliably.

maya: Proposal: add a sampled-prefetch-adjustment step when computing savings that scales sampled counts by 1 / sample_rate. Simpler than trying to reconstruct missing lineage.

sam: Scaling is ok but will amplify noise for low-volume tenants. UX suggestion: expose a dashboard toggle "Show sample-adjusted credits" and display a confidence meter when sample_rate < 0.1.

jess: :thumbsup: toggle + confidence bar sounds right. Also add tooltip explaining adjustment math and when it applies.

frank: Styling note: negative 'savings' should present as "net additional cost" with an explanatory hover. Red-only is scary; consider neutral color with explicit label.

maya: Backend API change needed: add optional param to preview endpoint, e.g. `/billing/preview?include_sample_adjustment=true`. Return `sample_rate` and `sampled_prefetch_count` fields on per-route rollups.

jess: Backend sketch: add `sampled_prefetch_count` and `sample_rate` to rollup rows; compute `adj_prefetch = sampled_prefetch_count / NULLIF(sample_rate,0)` at aggregation time and cap when sample_rate < 0.01 to avoid explosion. Will add unit tests.

sam: Important: totals must be conserved at invoice-level. If we adjust route-level numbers we need a reconciliation job that ensures sum(route_adjusted) == invoice_total (or flags diffs). Add a bisection test.

frank: ops-bot: create ticket for infra + ui work please.

ops-bot: INF-4521 created by jess: "sample-adjusted-prefetch-rollup + dashboard toggle" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4521

maya: Plan: jess implements telemetry + rollup changes + tests, sam adds UI toggle + confidence UX, i'll build reconciliation and run staging recompute. Target: canary next week.

jess: SG. Quick question — retrocompute last 7 days or only forward from deploy?

sam: lean toward recompute last 48h only to limit churn for customers and not rewrite too much history.

maya: 48h window + clear log entry in the console saying "recomputed with sample-adjustment". OK, moving forward. :rocket:
